items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: and then there was Freddy Tunstoll. Freddy used to copy music, and he'd -- just like printing.

ctx.x: These guys you met, did Dan Carey read?
No, Dan was an ear piano player. Eubie was -- I mean, Joe Burrough, he was an ear piano -- and then there was Freddy Tunstoll. Freddy used to copy music, and he'd -- just like printing.
Well, he evidently could read then, huh?
